items.title: Why the Market Dipped But Eli Lilly (LLY) Gained Today
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) concluded the recent trading session at $1, signifying a +1.99% move from its prior day's close.

items.title: Is This LLY Stock Dip Big Enough To Be Worth Buying?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) trades near $1,120, about 13% below the high it set in August, and the question is whether to step in. The stock's record after sharp falls is clean but short. That record asks for the better part of a year and more pain before it pays. And this fall is not the kind of fall that record is built on.

items.title: Eli Lilly Eyes Obesity Access Expansion With Zepbound, Foundayo and Pipeline Bets
items.summary: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) is pursuing a broad obesity portfolio designed to address different patient needs across treatment initiation, maintenance, efficacy, tolerability and dosing convenience, according to Ilya Yuffa, the company’s executive vice president and president of Lilly USA and G

items.title: Why Is Pfizer Stock Paying You So Much To Wait?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) throws off free cash worth 7.0% of its market value a year, against 4.4% for the median S&P 500 company. Everything turns on whether the cash holds. Management's answer is a wait: it says it is well positioned to return to growth from 2029 onward. A 6.2% dividend yield over the past twelve months is what that wait pays.

items.title: Novo Nordisk Is Dropping Some Weight. Can a Rebrand Save the Stock?
items.summary: The Danish drugmaker is shortening its name to Novo, but it will take more than a lean rebrand to win back Wall Street.

items.title: AZN's Etcamah Fails Late-Stage Study for First-line Breast Cancer
items.summary: AstraZeneca's Etcamah fails to improve PFS significantly in a phase III first-line breast cancer study, while its approved use remains unaffected.

items.title: Will Morgan Stanley's NVO Downgrade Deepen Patent and Rival Woes?
items.summary: Novo faces a tougher growth outlook as Morgan Stanley downgrades the stock to Underweight, citing muted growth, patent risks and rising pressure from Lilly.

items.title: Novo Nordisk rebrands as Novo to compete in obesity market
items.summary: The Danish drugmaker unveiled a new name, slogan, and set of cultural principles as it trails Eli Lilly in the obesity drug market
